test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six colleagues, Raj, Shruti, Mayank, Preyesh, Viren and Ojas, study in the same class. Viren is taller than Raj. Ojas has the same height has Preyesh, who is taller than Shruti. Mayank is taller than Viren. Raj is not taller than Shruti. Which of the following options is NOT necessarily correct according to the given information?
solution: __EXPLANATION:__ **__Six colleagues:__ **Raj, Shruti, Mayank, Preyesh, Viren and Ojas 1. Viren is taller than Raj. **Viren > Raj.** 2. Mayank is taller than Viren. Mayank** >** Viren > Raj. 3. Raj is not taller than Shruti. Shruti > Raj.
